title: BPA for Crane and Heavy Forklift Rental Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > NGB > W7MT USPFO ACTIVITY AL ARNG
description:
The purpose of this amendment is to: 

 
	 Extend Quotation Receipt Date: The deadline for receipt of quotations is hereby extended from December 7, 2026, to December 11, 2026, at 4:00 PM Central Time. 
	 Incorporate Contract Clauses: Formally incorporates FAR 52.228-5 (Insurance - Work on a Government Installation) and modifies the full-text inclusion of FAR 52.219-14 (Limitations on Subcontracting) (Deviation 2026-O0038). 
	 Update Section L & Section M: Conforms quotation instructions and evaluation factors regarding Section B equipment class dominion over narrative PWS sizes, formal subcontractor Letters of Commitment, dual SCA Directory labor classifications, and five-year cumulative monitoring under FAR 52.219-14. 
	 Publish Consolidated Vendor Q&A: Formally incorporates official Government responses to prospective offeror Questions 1 through 18 as Attachment 1. 
	 Except as provided herein, all terms and conditions of the solicitation, as heretofore changed, remain unchanged and in full force and effect.
